notes: Positive SET, negative RESET (current wiring), always with a 10 kOhm series resistor. SET is a single step to the bottom of the range (~64-74 kOhm); RESET is a repeatable staircase of ~4% per -2.0 V / 0.5 s pulse. Applied voltages are at the 2 V safety cap, so RESET uses a fixed amplitude (start = max) and only the pulse count varies. Lift the probes before touching any cable; check R before each run (abnormal if below ~20 kOhm).
